t: The 32-bit chip inside the Arduino UNO R4 boards, still speaking 5 volts.
steps: Buy an Arduino UNO R4 Minima or UNO R4 WiFi from the Arduino Store or SparkFun. The Minima costs about 14 to 20 US dollars.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Open the Boards Manager and add the Arduino UNO R4 boards package.
Plug the board in with a USB-C cable that carries data.
Open the Blink example and upload it to see the LED flash.
Try the LED matrix examples next on the UNO R4 WiFi.
Check each library page for UNO R4 support before you use it.
Double-tap the reset button to recover a board that stops showing up over USB.
meta: Wild Open. From $5.90. A few stores.
